contentEn:
Whole-house renovation costs in Richmond in 2026 range from $55,000 for a targeted bathroom and flooring refresh to $280,000+ for a full kitchen-and-bathrooms gut with marble-look finishes. The majority of homeowners in Richmond spend $90,000–$160,000 when combining kitchen upgrades, bathroom renovation and new flooring throughout the home.

At Reno Stars, every whole-house project includes a written scope, a fixed-price contract, a BC building permit package, $5M general liability insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage and a 3-year craftsmanship warranty. We have completed 4 whole-house projects in Richmond, ranging from a budget-friendly 600 sq ft condo flooring and bathroom refresh to a full interior transformation with marble-look kitchen, custom millwork and premium tile throughout.

What Does a Whole-House Renovation Include in Richmond?

A whole-house renovation in Richmond typically means coordinating work across multiple rooms while maintaining occupancy or limiting disruption to the household. Common scopes include:

  • Kitchen refresh or full gut: cabinetry, countertops, appliance upgrades, lighting and backsplash
  • Bathroom renovation: tile, vanities, fixtures, waterproofing and exhaust upgrades
  • Hardwood or luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the main living areas
  • Interior painting, trim and baseboard replacement
  • Electrical upgrades: additional outlets, pot lights, panel capacity review

Richmond's climate also means exterior door weatherstripping and energy efficiency upgrades are frequently included in whole-house scopes.

Richmond Whole-House Renovation Cost Breakdown (2026)

ScopeInvestment RangeWhat's Included
Bathroom + Flooring Refresh$55,000 – $90,000One full bathroom renovation, LVP flooring in kitchen/dining/living, interior paint, trim
Kitchen + One Bathroom$90,000 – $130,000Full kitchen renovation with cabinetry/countertops/appliances, one bathroom gut, flooring throughout
Kitchen + Two Bathrooms + Flooring$130,000 – $180,000Two full bathrooms, full kitchen, hardwood/LVP throughout, interior paint, electrical additions
Complete Interior Transformation$180,000 – $280,000+Marble-look kitchen, all bathrooms gutted and retiled, custom millwork, premium lighting, full flooring replacement

How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take in Richmond?

Richmond projects follow City of Richmond building permit requirements. Most whole-house renovations fall under BC Building Code Part 9 residential requirements. A typical timeline:

  • Bathroom + Flooring Refresh: 6–10 weeks
  • Kitchen + One Bathroom: 10–14 weeks
  • Kitchen + Two Bathrooms: 14–20 weeks
  • Complete Interior: 18–28 weeks

BC Step 3 energy efficiency requirements (in force since December 2022) apply to substantial renovations, adding energy advisor coordination and envelope testing to the permit process.

Richmond-Specific Considerations

Richmond's soil conditions — part of the Fraser River delta — mean foundations in older homes (particularly in the Broadmoor and Shellmont neighbourhoods) may require special consideration during any work that affects floor structure or load-bearing walls. Most whole-house projects do not involve foundation work, but Reno Stars includes a structural assessment in every pre-construction evaluation.

Richmond's multilingual community means we provide project documentation in English, Mandarin and Cantonese as standard practice.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Real Richmond Projects

See the work behind these numbers:

  • Whole Home Renovation with Marble-Look Kitchen in Richmond — full interior transformation including marble-look kitchen, custom millwork, premium tile
  • House Renovation with Kitchen, Bathrooms and Flooring in Richmond — kitchen gut, two bathroom renovations, new flooring throughout
  • Budget Friendly Condo Renovation in Richmond — targeted scope at lower investment point
  • Condo Flooring Replacement in Richmond — flooring and fixture refresh

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a whole-house renovation in Richmond in 2026?

Based on 4 completed Richmond whole-house projects at Reno Stars, the average cost is approximately $110,000–$140,000 for a kitchen plus one bathroom plus flooring throughout. Entry-level refresh projects (bathroom plus flooring) start at $55,000; complete interior transformations with marble finishes and custom millwork reach $200,000–$280,000.

Do I need a permit for a whole-house renovation in Richmond?

Yes. The City of Richmond requires building permits for any work that involves structural changes, electrical upgrades, plumbing modifications or changes to exterior walls. Flooring and painting alone typically do not require a permit, but bathroom and kitchen renovation always do. Reno Stars handles the full BC building permit package as part of every whole-house project.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Richmond?

A single-bathroom plus flooring project takes 6–10 weeks. A full kitchen plus two-bathroom project takes 14–20 weeks. Complete interior transformations take 18–28 weeks. All timelines include the permit process and are subject to City of Richmond inspection scheduling.

Can I live in my home during a whole-house renovation?

In most cases, yes. Reno Stars coordinates work in phases to allow families to remain in the home throughout construction. We schedule noisy work (demolition, tile cutting) during reasonable hours and use dust barriers to separate living areas from construction zones.

Does Reno Stars offer warranties on whole-house renovation work?

Every Reno Stars project carries a 3-year craftsmanship warranty plus the manufacturers' warranties on all installed products. We also provide documentation of all work performed for future resale purposes.

2026年列治文整屋装修费用从55,000加元的浴室和地板翻新到280,000加元以上的高端全屋改造（包括大理石纹厨房、全新浴室和定制木工）。大多数列治文业主的全屋装修花费在90,000至160,000加元之间，涵盖厨房升级、浴室改造和全屋地板更换。

Reno Stars的每一个整屋项目均包含书面范围、固定价格合同、BC省建筑许可包、500万加元综合责任险、WorkSafeBC保险和3年工艺质保。我们已在列治文完成4个整屋项目，范围从经济型600平方尺公寓地板和浴室翻新到配备大理石纹厨房、定制木工和高级瓷砖的全面室内改造。

列治文整屋装修包含哪些内容？

列治文整屋装修通常涉及协调多个房间的工程，同时尽量减少对居住的干扰。常见范围包括：

  • 厨房翻新或全拆：橱柜、台面、设备升级、照明和防溅板
  • 浴室改造：瓷砖、洗手台、固定装置、防水和排气升级
  • 主生活区全新硬木地板或豪华乙烯基塑料地板
  • 室内油漆、装饰线条和踢脚线更换
  • 电气升级：增加插座、筒灯、电路板容量评估

列治文的气候条件也意味着外墙门防水条和节能升级经常被纳入整屋装修范围。

列治文整屋装修费用明细（2026年）

范围投资区间包含内容
浴室 + 地板翻新$55,000 – $90,000一间全浴室改造、厨房/餐厅/客厅LVP地板、室内油漆、装饰线条
厨房 + 一间浴室$90,000 – $130,000全厨房改造（橱柜/台面/设备）、一间浴室全拆、整体地板
厨房 + 两间浴室 + 地板$130,000 – $180,000两间全浴室、全厨房、全屋硬木/LVP地板、室内油漆、电气增项
全面室内改造$180,000 – $280,000+大理石纹厨房、两间浴室全拆重铺瓷砖、定制木工、高级照明、全屋地板更换

列治文整屋装修需要多长时间？

列治文项目遵循温哥华市建筑许可要求。大多数整屋装修属于BC省建筑规范第9部分住宅要求。典型时间线：

  • 浴室 + 地板翻新：6–10周
  • 厨房 + 一间浴室：10–14周
  • 厨房 + 两间浴室：14–20周
  • 全面室内改造：18–28周

BC省第3步节能要求（2022年12月生效）适用于重大装修，在许可流程中增加了能源顾问协调和围护结构测试。

列治文特殊注意事项

列治文的土壤条件（位于菲沙河三角洲部分）意味着建于Broadmoor和Shellmont等老社区的房屋在进行影响楼层结构或承重墙的工程时可能需要特殊考虑。大多数整屋装修不涉及地基工程，但Reno Stars在每个施工前评估中都包含结构评估。

列治文的多元文化社区意味着我们默认提供英文、普通话和粤语的项目文档。

  • 列治文大理石纹厨房全屋装修 — 全面室内改造，包括大理石纹厨房、定制木工、高级瓷砖
  • 列治文厨房、浴室和地板房屋装修 — 厨房全拆、两间浴室改造、全屋新地板
  • 列治文经济型公寓装修 — 较低投资点的精准范围
  • 列治文公寓地板更换 — 地板和固定装置翻新

常见问题

2026年列治文整屋装修的平均费用是多少？

根据Reno Stars完成的4个列治文整屋项目数据，平均费用约为110,000至140,000加元（厨房+一间浴室+全屋地板）。入门级翻新项目（浴室+地板）起价55,000加元；配备大理石饰面和定制木工的高端全面改造可达200,000至280,000加元。

列治文整屋装修需要许可证吗？

需要。列治文市要求对任何涉及结构变更、电气升级、管道修改或外墙变更的工程颁发建筑许可证。单独的地板和油漆工程通常不需要许可证，但浴室和厨房改造则必须申请。Reno Stars作为每个整屋项目的一部分，负责处理完整的BC省建筑许可包。

列治文整屋装修需要多长时间？

单浴室+地板项目需要6–10周。厨房+两间浴室项目需要14–20周。全面室内改造需要18–28周。所有时间线均包含许可流程，并受温哥华市检查日程安排约束。

整屋装修期间我可以住在家里吗？

在大多数情况下可以。Reno Stars分阶段协调工程，让家庭在整个施工期间留在家中。我们会在合理时间安排噪音工程（拆除、瓷砖切割），并使用防尘屏障将生活区与施工区隔开。

Reno Stars是否为整屋装修工程提供质保？

每个Reno Stars项目均包含3年工艺质保以及所有安装产品的制造商质保。我们还提供所有工程的文档，用于未来转售目的。

Điều kiện đất ở đồng bằng sông Fraser của Richmond có nghĩa là nền móng trong các ngôi nhà cũ có thể cần đánh giá kết cấu khi thực hiện bất kỳ công việc nào ảnh hưởng đến kết cấu sàn hoặc tường chịu lực. Reno Stars bao gồm đánh giá này trong mỗi đánh giá trước thi công.

Đang lên kế hoạch cải tạo? Nhận báo giá miễn phí từ Reno Stars.

Các câu hỏi thường gặp

Chi phí trung bình của cải tạo toàn bộ ở Richmond năm 2026 là bao nhiêu?

Dựa trên 4 dự án hoàn thành, chi phí trung bình là khoảng $110,000–$140,000 cho bếp cộng một phòng tắm cộng sàn toàn bộ. Mức khởi điểm từ $55,000; biến đổi nội thất hoàn toàn đạt $200,000–$280,000.

Tôi có cần giấy phép để cải tạo toàn bộ ở Richmond không?

Có. Thành phố Richmond yêu cầu giấy phép xây dựng cho các thay đổi về kết cấu, nâng cấp điện, sửa đổi đường ống hoặc thay đổi tường ngoài. Reno Stars xử lý gói giấy phép xây dựng BC đầy đủ như tiêu chuẩn.

Cải tạo toàn bộ mất bao lâu?

Phòng tắm + Sàn: 6–10 tuần. Bếp + Hai Phòng tắm: 14–20 tuần. Biến đổi nội thất hoàn toàn: 18–28 tuần. Tất cả đều bao gồm quy trình cấp phép và kiểm tra của Thành phố Richmond.

Tôi có thể ở trong nhà trong quá trình thi công không?

Trong hầu hết các trường hợp, có thể. Reno Stars phối hợp công việc theo giai đoạn để các gia đình có thể ở trong nhà trong suốt quá trình xây dựng.

Reno Stars có cung cấp bảo hành không?

Mỗi dự án Reno Stars đi kèm bảo hành tay nghề 3 năm cộng với bảo hành của nhà sản xuất trên tất cả các sản phẩm được lắp đặt.
